title: MV CHILDREN OF LIGHT - TRIP TO DRAGON'S LAIR

posts.author: yongilcool
posts.body:
Screenshots:
​
Trailer:
HI, I MADE THIS WITH RPG MAKER MV FOR ABOUT A YEAR NOW BY MYSELF
AND FINALLY COMPLETED IT!
IT'S BEEN SO HARD DEVELOPING THE GAME AND DRAWING CHARACTERS AT THE SAME TIME BUT IT HAS BEEN A GREAT EXPERIENCE.
THANK YOU FOR MANY PEOPLE HELPING ME THROUGH THIS. AND FOR GREAT PLUGINS.
Synopsis:
An orphan boy 'Ethan' dream of god telling him to go slay the dragon one day and
he begins the jorney to slay the dragon.
He meets Bella who happens to have had the same dream and they become a party for slaying the dragon.
There is a maze and hidden traps to get through.
It is rather a simple yet satisfying story game with table top like elements.
The game is an adventure game made with rpgmv.
It will require the player to type the code from the images included to proceed through stages.
AT THE BEGINNING, I WANTED TO MAKE SOMETHING RPG WITH A SYSTEM LIKE A TABLETOP RPG GAME OR BOARD GAME
SO I TRIED USING NUMBER COMBINATION TO CONTINUE THE MISSIONS IN GAME.
AI USAGES:
All characters are my own creation but
I got the help of AI for only background images in illustrations.
I THINK IT'S KINDA DIFFERENT AND A BIT TAKING TIME BUT SIMPLE AND YET SATISFYING.
I RECOMMEND YOU TRY THE DEMO VERSION FIRST.
I HOPE YOU CAN ENJOY THE GAME
